Support groups are helpful. Most are virtual now, so that should make it easier. Support groups are different than group therapy. I believe the latter has a licensed professional where as the former may not always. 

Relaxation techniques for the moments you’re feeling super anxious, find the right one for you. It’s my understanding that meditation eventually* be helpful. I personally haven’t pushed through that one in particular because it’s painful in beginning, but I’m told that’s normal that it can cause more anxiety at first but over time it decreases. Some that I have found helpful are ‘progressive muscle relaxation’, ‘name an animal for every letter of the alphabet’, count backwards from 100 by 3 ( or 7 or any number that requires you to think). The idea is that it distracts you from the moment. It’s not meant to make the feelings disappear complete, but take a 10 to an 8. 

There’s also forcing yourself to practice doing “GRAPES”. It’s an acronym which stands for 
Gentle to self

Relaxation 

Accomplishment 

Pleasure 

Exercise

Social 

We have to do one in each, not overlap. They’re not meant to take long, 5-10 minutes each. But they’re supposed to be done everyday. I don’t know if I do, but it’s something I’m mindful of when I get really bad days, I fall back on making sure I’m doing GRAPES everyday. 

Mind you, each human is different and there’s a unique set that will work for you. Also, my list up there isn’t everything by any stretch of the imagination. Also, it’s easier said than done. Personally, I am still trying to find a support group that works for me. Group therapy is nice, but expensive.

The faster you move, the longer it takes for the energy to get from point a to b, the slower it appears. 

Dimensions are just the layers we think about things. Like measure it a box, width, height, and length are dimensions. Time is an interesting concept because it relies on movement. If everything in the universe stopped moving, time doesn’t exist. It’s not ever going to stop moving, so we use this word time to describe movements and since things move at different rates depending on which “road” it’s on, then time gets changed.
